$comment: Editorial layer for the public atlas. Keyed by permanent campus id (slug + state). Edit this file, not build_data.py. 'sourceUrls' are curated citations added on top of queue evidence URLs; 'overrides' replace generated fields; 'summary' is visitor-facing text. 'outcome' is the reviewed campus outcome (closed-campus-reused only when an operating use is documented; closed-campus-unknown when it is not; merged-campus-continues when the institution merged and the campus carries on; not-a-closure when the institution continues). 'outcomeBasis' says why. The builder no longer infers it from the presence of a transfer event.

green-mountain-college-vt.summary: Green Mountain closed in 2019. Raj Bhakta bought the Poultney campus at auction in 2020 for $4.55M, and his redevelopment plan stalled. In October 2026 he sold it for $6M to Florida evangelist Tommie Zito, who plans a Christ-centered Z University with classes by fall 2027.

notre-dame-college-oh.name: Notre Dame College
notre-dame-college-oh.summary: Notre Dame College closed in 2024. Akron Children's Hospital won the May 2026 receivership auction with an $8M bid for two parcels, and a federal judge approved the sale on May 28. Cuyahoga County records show the receiver's deed to the hospital recorded July 10, 2026. A recorded memorandum shows the hospital leased the former Regina High School building to Yeshiva Derech Hatorah under a 50-year ground lease dated July 31 (local reporting called it a $2.2M purchase). South Euclid has noticed a December 10 hearing on rezoning both parcels. No operating hospital facility or school has been verified.
notre-dame-college-oh.outcomeBasis: Reviewed against the research workbook (checked 2026-11-14/15): receiver transfer and ground lease documented; no operating replacement school or healthcare facility verified

The Albany County Pine Hills Land Authority bought the 26.5-acre campus for $35M in March 2025 and since late 2025 has sold or agreed to sell buildings to Albany County, UAlbany, Hudson Valley Community College, and a private buyer, with a developer solicitation open for the northeast corner.

wells-college-ny.name: Wells College
wells-college-ny.summary: Wells closed in 2024. The board accepted a $12.5M bid from the Hiawatha Institute for Indigenous Knowledge, then in June 2026 said the sale would not proceed; Hiawatha sued to preserve it. In September 2026 a judge approved selling the college's collections. On November 2, 2026 the college confirmed a new agreement with Paul Warshauer, reported at $10M, with senior living, sports and education proposed. It depends on the outstanding litigation and has a February 15 closing target. The 2026 village tax roll still lists Wells College as the owner of two campus parcels, so no buyer holds the campus yet.
wells-college-ny.outcomeBasis: Reviewed against the research workbook (checked 2026-11-14/15): sale unresolved; no replacement operating use verified

wells-college-ny.editorialNote: No buyer holds title and no reuse has occurred; the 2026 village tax roll still lists Wells College. The buyer sector and replacement system record the Hiawatha Institute bid that collapsed in June 2026 (some sources give $12.3M), while a conditional November 2026 Warshauer agreement proposes senior living. The classification is provisional until a sale is resolved.

WashU said in December 2025 it had no plan for the site, and Clayton Schools was negotiating a temporary bridge campus there as of October 2026.

The Presentation Sisters and the City of Aberdeen agreed in November 2023 that the city would take the dome, Strode Center, soccer field, and an undeveloped parcel, and the council approved a $1.75M purchase in February 2024. The Sisters announced in April 2025 that they would remove the Motherhouse for a green space.

finlandia-university-mi.name: Finlandia University
finlandia-university-mi.summary: Finlandia closed in 2023 and its 27 buildings entered state receivership. The city of Hancock bought five parcels, including three halls for $30,000 in total, and private investors bought others at a December 2023 auction. Hancock is designing a conversion of two halls into 47 housing units. MTEC SmartZone runs an accelerator on the fourth floor of the former Jutila building, now Skyline Commons; it is reported as the condominium owner, though a later funder calls it a tenant, so present tenure is open.

On the east side Kisco Senior Living opened The Newbury of Brookline, a 159-unit senior community, in December 2024.

Dowling's separate 105-acre Shirley campus sold to Triple Five for $14M in 2018 and to Hampshire Venture Partners in 2025.

urbana-university-oh.name: Urbana University
urbana-university-oh.summary: Urbana University closed in 2020. CBRE listed the 115-acre campus in 2021, and Champaign County records show Urbana Investment Group LLC bought 29 parcels from Franklin University on December 7, 2022 for $8.5M in total. A group including Braxton Miller was reported as involved, for an athlete-development institute. The main parcel is flagged for foreclosure in county records but not for sheriff's sale. The city went to court in 2025 over fire-code violations after players and coaches were reported present in March 2025. In January 2026 Ohio's governor proposed the site for a Coast Guard training facility, with no acquisition. Current occupancy is unverified.

daniel-webster-college-nh.name: Daniel Webster College
daniel-webster-college-nh.summary: Daniel Webster closed after the ITT collapse; sources date the closure between 2016 and May 2017. Sui Liu won the 2017 bankruptcy auction with an $11.6M bid and the property is held by Xinhua Education Consulting Services. The aviation facilities went separately to Southern New Hampshire University for about $400,000. Nashua sought state money to buy the campus in 2026.

virginia-intermont-college-va.name: Virginia Intermont College
virginia-intermont-college-va.summary: Virginia Intermont closed in 2014 and its 37-acre Bristol campus was sold at auction in 2016 for $3.3M to U.S. Magis, a China-based company. A December 2024 fire destroyed the four oldest buildings. In 2025 the city petitioned to seize the property for back taxes, withdrew after about $605,000 was paid, and the owner is pursuing state certification for a new school; no redevelopment had begun by December 2025.

southern-vermont-college-vt.name: Southern Vermont College
southern-vermont-college-vt.summary: Southern Vermont closed in 2019. Southwestern Vermont Health Care won the bankruptcy auction for the campus at $4.65M and closed in December 2020, using it for a COVID clinic. In March 2023 it announced an agreement to sell about 366 acres to Alfred Weissman Real Estate for a planned resort. That sale has not been reported closed: Vermont's Act 250 agenda lists SVHC Realty as landowner and AWRE Vermont Resorts as applicant for a resort with 102 guest rooms and 24 residential units, with a hearing set for November 30, 2026. Public trail access is documented, and current building occupancy is not.
southern-vermont-college-vt.outcomeBasis: Reviewed against the research workbook (checked 2026-11-14/15): public trail access documented; building occupancy unverified, later developer closing unverified

st-gregory-s-university-ok.name: St. Gregory's University
st-gregory-s-university-ok.summary: St. Gregory's closed in 2017. Hobby Lobby bought the Shawnee campus for $8M in 2018 and leased it to Oklahoma Baptist University, then donated it to OBU in December 2019. In June 2024 OBU exchanged it back to St. Gregory's Abbey, which is considering redevelopment.

gwu-virginia-science-and-technology-camp.name: GWU Virginia Science & Technology Campus
gwu-virginia-science-and-technology-camp.summary: GW sold its Ashburn campus to Amazon Data Services; the university announced the completed sale on February 27, 2026, with an option to keep using the campus for five years, and county records put the price at $427M. GW's operations there continue, so this is a property sale, not a university closure. In October 2026 Loudoun County announced a preliminary agreement with Amazon that would send about 25 acres to the county and redirect the rest toward housing and mixed-use rezoning. It is not final, and no housing has been built.
gwu-virginia-science-and-technology-camp.outcomeBasis: Reviewed against the research workbook (checked 2026-11-14/15): GW continues operating; the property sale is not a university closure
